steps.title: ocr.img_to_text(image_path, ocr_dir)
steps.sub: called from Python, holds the GIL
steps.detail: Two strings: the image file and the model directory. Nothing is cached between calls — config and weights are loaded again every time.

steps.title: Config::load(ocr_dir)
steps.detail: If config.json exists it is parsed with serde; unknown keys are ignored, missing keys are an error. If it does not exist, Config::default() is written to the directory and used.

steps.title: config.device()
steps.detail: The shipped config says cpu. CUDA and Metal would need candle compiled with those features, which Cargo.toml does not enable.

steps.title: load_and_split
steps.detail: Grayscale, distance-to-background thresholding, median filter, connected components, size filters, crop and EMNIST-style centring. Details on the Image to letters page.

steps.title: CNN::load
steps.detail:
The layers are created from conv_count, kernel_size, pool_after and the vocabulary size, then the weights are loaded from model_name.

If the weights file does not exist, nothing is loaded and the network runs with random initial weights — without any error.

branches.label: shapes do not match the file → ValueError

steps.title: forward + top_k per letter
steps.detail: Each letter tensor goes through conv/ReLU/pool layers and the final linear layer. Softmax turns the logits into probabilities, and the best max_candidates characters with their probabilities are kept.

steps.title: candidates
steps.detail: Every kept prefix is extended with every candidate of the next position; the sum of log-probabilities ranks them and only the best max_candidates survive each round.

steps.title: list[str]
steps.detail: The strings only. If segmentation found no letters at all, the list is [""] — one empty string, not an error.

steps.title: Silent random output
steps.detail: The call succeeds and returns strings, but they are guesses of an untrained network. The usual cause is a wrong ocr_dir or model_name.

steps.title: ValueError
steps.detail: img_to_text maps each Err to PyValueError with the message text. A Rust panic (for example a too short pool_after) is not caught and arrives as pyo3_runtime.PanicException.

steps.title: Bandcamp.search()
steps.detail: The provider loads bandcamp.com/search?... with the session's cookies.

steps.title: _isClientChallenge(html)
steps.detail: Without the markers the results are parsed normally and the OCR is never touched.

steps.title: Retries left?
steps.detail: Each detected challenge counts one attempt. After the third the search raises TaskFailedError asking for manual help.

steps.title: Open the challenge headless
steps.detail: A Playwright browser with the session's cookie file. The page must be rendered by a browser because the image is created by script.

steps.title: Cut out the image
steps.detail: The Base64 data is decoded and written to <timestamp>-Bandcamp-captcha.jpeg in the current working directory. The file is deleted in a finally block.

steps.title: ocr.img_to_text(file, OCR_PATH)
steps.detail: OCR_PATH is PythonModule/providers/ocr, resolved relative to the provider file. A ValueError from the module becomes a TaskFailedError with the model path in its hints.

steps.title: Try each candidate
steps.detail: Candidates are tried in order. Success is only recognised when the click raises and the page has changed; a solved captcha after a normal click is reported as failure and only noticed on the next round.

steps.title: Cookies back into the session
steps.detail: Bandcamp remembers a solved challenge in a cookie. The browser saves its cookies to the shared cookie file when it stops; the HTTP session reloads them, and the loop fetches the search page again.

steps.title: Search results
steps.detail: Normal provider output. The OCR has done its job once the challenge page no longer appears.

steps.title: TaskFailedError
steps.detail: The message suggests solving the captcha manually. Since the solved state lives in the cookie file, a captcha solved once in a normal browser with the same cookies also unblocks the server.
